answer: Require many independent routes, not one endorsement. An identity turns eligible only when the honest core can reach it through K node-disjoint vouching paths, each a separate thread back to the wharf of trusted seeds. A sybil farm attaches through a thin bottleneck, so it can offer at most a handful of genuinely disjoint routes before they collide on a shared chokepoint. Honest members, woven across the open dune of the graph, supply K distinct paths easily; manufactured clusters simply cannot, no matter how many fakes stand behind the neck.
